1.w: Therefore be imitators of God, as beloved children,

2.w: and walk in love, just as Christ also loved us and gave Himself up for us [as] an offering and a sacrifice to God, into a fragrance of a sweet smell.

3.w: But let sexual immorality and all impurity or covetousness not even be named among you⁺, just as is proper to saints,

4.w: and shamefulness, and foolish talk, or crude joking, which are not fitting, but rather thanksgiving.

5.w: For this you⁺ know, realizing that every sexually immoral person, or impure person, or covetous person (who is an idolater), has no inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.

6.w: Let no one deceive you⁺ with empty words, for because of these things the wrath of God comes upon the sons of disobedience.

7.w: Therefore do not be partakers with them.

8.w: For you⁺ were once darkness, but now [you are] light in the Lord. Walk as children of light—

9.w: for the fruit of the light [is] in all goodness and righteousness and truth—

10.w: discerning what is well-pleasing to the Lord.

11.w: And do not have fellowship with the unfruitful deeds of darkness, but rather even expose [them].

12.w: For it is shameful even to speak [of] the things being done by them in secret.

13.w: But everything being exposed by the light is made manifest, for everything being made manifest is light.

14.w: Therefore it says: “Awake you, the one sleeping, and rise up out from the dead, and Christ will shine upon you.”

15.w: Therefore watch carefully how you⁺ walk, not as unwise but as wise,

16.w: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.

17.w: Because of this, do not be foolish, but understand what [is] the will of the Lord.

18.w: And do not be drunk with wine, in which is debauchery, but be filled in the Spirit,

19.w: speaking to each other in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody in your⁺ heart to the Lord,

20.w: giving thanks always for all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to the God and Father.

21.w: Be submitting to one another in fear of Christ:

22.w: wives, to [your] own husbands as to the Lord;

23.w: for the husband is head of the wife as also Christ [is] the head of the church, He Himself Savior of the body.

24.w: But as the church submits to Christ, so also wives to [their] husbands in everything.

25.w: Husbands, love [your] wives, just as Christ also loved the church and gave Himself up for her,

26.w: so that He might sanctify her, having cleansed [her] by the washing of water in the word,

27.w: so that He might present to Himself the church in glory, not having spot or wrinkle or any of such things, but that she may be holy and blameless.

28.w: So also husbands ought to love their own wives as their own bodies. The one loving his own wife loves himself.

29.w: For no one at any time hated his own flesh, but he nourishes and cherishes it just as Christ also [does] the church.

30.w: For we are members of His body.

31.w: “Because of this, a man will leave his father and mother and be joined to his wife, and the two will be into one flesh.”

32.w: This mystery is great, but I speak as to Christ and as to the church.

33.w: However, you⁺ also, every one, let each so love his wife as himself; and the wife, that she may respect the husband.
